Venice Electric Light Parade

Los Angeles, CA · Venice · Social · Cruiser · E-bike · Mixed

FamilyBeginner friendly

Venice Electric Light Parade is a social, cruiser and e-bike group ride in Los Angeles, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 6:35 pm from Venice Beach. Pace: slow, party pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:35 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow, party pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Venice Electric Light Parade group ride

A weekly lit-up night ride along Venice Beach. Any human- or electric-powered ride is welcome, no gas vehicles. Family friendly, no smoking or drinking. Bring lights; wheel lights are not required.
